criteria: Nations, regions, subregions, settlements, landmarks, institutions, ruins and other realms with narrative relevance.
notes: Generated from the discovery research pass on 2026-10-11 and maintained by hand afterwards. Status is computed by tools/check_coverage.py --sync.

items.name: Aaru Village
items.notes: Main desert settlement in Land of Lower Setekh; includes Village Chief's House.

items.name: Ancient Sacred Mountain
items.notes: The Sacred City of Tollan, capital of the ancient dragon civilization. A separate map area entered through the volcano; first accessed in 'Nahuatzin's Leap'.

items.name: Avidya Forest
items.notes: Area containing Sumeru City, Gandharva Ville, Chinvat Ravine, Gandha Hill, Yazadaha Pool.

items.name: Caravan Ribat
items.notes: Caravan station on the rainforest-desert border.

items.name: Chenyu Vale
items.notes: Tea-growing subregion around Mt. Yaojun, once ruled by the adeptus Herblord (the Mistress of Chenyu Vale). Its areas are Upper Vale, Southern Mountain and Mt. Laixin.

items.name: Court of Fontaine
items.notes: Capital city; once Focalors' court, now under Chief Justice Neuvillette. Use this rather than a 'fontaine-city' id. | merged faction.court-of-fontaine: Fontaine's government (Archon, Iudex, Maisons) seated at Palais Mermonia; wiki page is primarily the location (city) — disambiguate from location entry.

items.name: Dharma Forest
items.notes: Rainforest subregion of Sumeru; reachable from The Chasm (Liyue). Contains Avidya, Lokapala, Ardravi, Ashavan, Vissudha, Vanarana, Lost Nursery.

items.name: Dragonspine
items.notes: location_type: area (snow mountain). Historically Vindagnyr; site of Sal Vindagnyr, the Skyfrost Nail and Durin's corpse; Subzero Climate. Mentioned in lore since 1.0, area added 1.2.

items.name: Enkanomiya
items.notes: Underground realm beneath Watatsumi; formerly Byakuyakoku / Tokoyokoku, originally Delphi Pytho. 'Byakuyakoku' redirects here - covers Byakuyakoku remains. | Underground realm beneath Watatsumi Island. Formerly Byakuyakoku/Tokoyokoku and originally Delphi Pytho (a unified-civilization nation). Sometimes counted as part of the Dark Sea. Placed in this scope per coordination.

items.name: Favonius Cathedral
items.notes: location_type: point of interest (cathedral), Mondstadt City. Church of Favonius, worship of Barbatos; Barbara, Rosaria; Holy Lyre der Himmel theft (Prologue).

items.name: Fontaine
items.notes: Nation of Hydro (Focalors, Furina; now under Neuvillette). Fixed nation id; may duplicate a nations-scope entry.

items.name: Fortress of Meropide
items.notes: Underwater prison run by Duke Wriothesley; credit-coupon economy; over the Primordial Sea passage.

items.name: Frost Moon
items.notes: One of the Three Moons; explorable subregion (Lunar Highlands, Moontide Sea, Dark Side of the Moon) reached via Moon Gazing quest; Archaeolune energy, low gravity. | The surviving moon (goddess Canon, now Columbina). In True Moon (6.3) it returned inside the false sky. Explorable map in 6.7 (Luna VIII) via the Moon Gazing quest. The game counts it as a Nod-Krai subregion, but it lies off Teyvat's surface. Coordinate with the Nod-Krai and cosmology scopes.

items.name: Gandharva Ville
items.notes: Forest Ranger village (Tighnari, Collei).

items.name: Girdle of the Sands
items.notes: Western desert subregion bordering Fontaine; Gavireh Lajavard and Realm of Farakhkert; Pari / Simurgh lore.

items.name: Glupov
items.notes: Satellite fortress-city within Snezhnograd, Fatui HQ, built 4th year of 799th Cycle by Anastasya's order; Mayor Pulcinella. Mentioned 6.3.

items.name: Golden House
items.notes: Mint where all of Teyvat's Mora is made, on Mt. Tianheng. The Exuvia was kept here and Childe was fought here. Its Trounce Domain is 'Enter the Golden House'.

items.name: Great Red Sand
items.notes: Desert subregion (King Deshret's former domain). Hypostyle Desert, Upper/Lower Setekh (3.1), Desert of Hadramaveth (3.4).

items.name: Guili Plains
items.notes: Ruins of the Guili Assembly, the ancient settlement of Guizhong and Morax. The Guili Assembly civilisation itself belongs in a lore entry.

items.name: Inazuma
items.notes: added: fixed nation id

items.name: Inazuma City
items.notes: Capital on Narukami Island; districts Tenryou and Hanamizaka; Tenshukaku above.

items.name: Jade Chamber
items.notes: Ningguang's floating palace above Liyue Harbor. Used against Osial in 1.1 and rebuilt later. Added as a map point of interest in 2.4.

items.name: Jueyun Karst
items.notes: Home of the adepti. Setting of the Archon Quest scenes with the adepti and the location of Taishan Mansion.

items.name: Kannazuka
items.notes: Area containing Tatarasuna and the Kujou Encampment (resistance war front).

items.name: Khaenri'ah
items.notes: Fixed nation id; included for scope completeness (may duplicate a locations scope). | Godless underground kingdom deep beneath the Sumeru desert (alias Dahri). Ruled first by the Crimson Moon Dynasty, then the Eclipse Dynasty. Destroyed in the Cataclysm 500 years ago. Not yet a playable region. 7.1 calls Anastasya the 'Mother of Khaenri'ah': Khaenri'ahns descend from Anastasya and Saarelainen.

items.name: Khaj-Nisut
items.notes: King Deshret's ruined capital/Eye of the Sands (redirect); City of Gold domain located here.

items.name: Knights of Favonius Headquarters
items.notes: location_type: point of interest (building), Mondstadt City. Acting Grand Master's office, Library (Lisa), Albedo's office; 'Mondstadt Library' redirects here.

items.name: Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau
items.notes: Colossal Fatui steel complex on Paha Isle (Dottore/Raskolnikov); co-developed Landcruisers with the Armory Palace.

items.name: Liyue
items.notes: added: fixed nation id

items.name: Liyue Harbor
items.notes: Capital and main port of Liyue, in the Sea of Clouds area. Districts: Chihu Rock, Feiyun Slope, Yujing Terrace. The Jade Chamber floats above it.

items.name: Mondstadt
items.notes: location_type: nation/region. Nation of Barbatos (Anemo, Freedom); governed by the Knights of Favonius; NE Teyvat. Areas: Starfell Valley, Galesong Hill, Windwail Highland, Brightcrown Mountains (1.0), Dragonspine (1.2), Windrest Peak (6.5/Luna VI).

items.name: Mondstadt City
items.notes: location_type: city (subarea of Starfell Valley). Also 'City of Mondstadt', 'Crown of the North'; on an island in Cider Lake; capital moved here after Decarabian's fall.

items.name: Narukami Island
items.notes: Main island and seat of the Shogunate; contains Inazuma City, Ritou, Mt. Yougou/Grand Narukami Shrine.

items.name: Nasha Town
items.notes: Main city/port of Nod-Krai; no official government, influenced by Voynich Guild, Curatorium of Secrets, Speranza, Fatui. Built of scrap metal, kuuvahki-powered industry. First mentioned 5.3.

items.name: Natlan
items.notes: added: fixed nation id

items.name: Night Kingdom
items.notes: Realm of the Wayob and the dead, created by Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night. It works as Natlan's ley lines. Overlaps with the cosmology/afterlife scope. | Realm of the Wayob and the dead beneath Natlan, created by Yohualtecuhtin. It works as Natlan's ley lines. Other-realm; coordinate with the Natlan scope. | merged cosmology.night-kingdom: Realm of the Wayob and the dead created by Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night. | Realm of the Wayob and the dead in Natlan; source of Nightsoul. Possible overlap with the cosmology scope.

items.name: Nod-Krai
items.notes: Autonomous region at southernmost Snezhnaya; formerly 'Nephilheim' (Natlantea era). Main city Nasha Town; controlling entity Voynich Guild. Made from leftover material from the Three Moons' creation. Mentioned from 5.1; playable from Luna I (6.0).

items.name: Ochkanatlan
items.notes: Map area: the 'seventh tribe' land of Och-Kan, a gloomy island built around the Cradle of Fleeting Dreams. There is a separate wiki page 'Ochkanatlan (Civilization)' that the lore/faction scope should cover.

items.name: Opera Epiclese
items.notes: Opera house serving as the main courthouse, on Erinnyes island; Fortress of Meropide lies beneath/behind it.

items.name: Palais Mermonia
items.notes: Seat of government / Iudex Neuvillette's office. Also a teleport POI page 'Court of Fontaine: Palais Mermonia'.

items.name: Port Ormos
items.notes: Main harbor of Sumeru in Ardravi Valley; Traveler's arrival point.

items.name: Ritou
items.notes: Port of entry for foreigners under Sakoku; Outlander Affairs Agency; Hiiragi Clan/Kanjou Commission presence.

items.name: Sal Vindagnyr
items.notes: location_type: ancient kingdom (ruins) on Vindagnyr/Dragonspine in the unified civilization era, destroyed by the Skyfrost Nail; Princess of Sal Vindagnyr. Wiki categorizes as Ancient Civilization terminology - coordinate with lore.ancient-civilisations. | Unified-civilization kingdom on Vindagnyr (Dragonspine), destroyed by the Skyfrost Nail. Historical kingdom; could also be a lore.ancient-civilisations entry. | merged lore.sal-vindagnyr: Ancient kingdom on Dragonspine destroyed by the Skyfrost Nail; ties to Celestial Nails and Khaenri'ah's founding era.

items.name: Sanctuary of Surasthana
items.notes: Dendro Archon's residence at the top of Sumeru City; Nahida's confinement.

items.name: Sangonomiya Shrine
items.notes: Seat of Divine Priestess Sangonomiya Kokomi and the resistance.

items.name: Sea of Bygone Eras
items.notes: Underwater ruins of Remuria (capital Capitolium, outer city Machimos). Covers the 'Remuria ruins'; the civilization itself is a lore entry (wiki: Remuria).

items.name: Seirai Island
items.notes: Storm-wracked island; Seirai Stormchasers questline; Asase Shrine, Koseki Village, Fort Hiraumi.

items.name: Skyfrost Nail
items.notes: location_type: subarea (Celestial Nail at Dragonspine's peak). Celestia's nail that destroyed Sal Vindagnyr; Peak of Vindagnyr domain.

items.name: Snezhnaya
items.notes: Cryo nation of the Tsaritsa; capital Snezhnograd; controlling entity Zapolyarny Palace; festival Krsnik Noc. Mentioned since 1.0; explorable 7.0 (released 2026-08-12).

items.name: Snezhnograd
items.notes: Capital; seat of Zapolyarny Palace, Snezhnograd Veche, Druzhna HQ, Adventurers' Guild HQ, Kresnik's Torch; Mayor Pulcinella. Alchemy outlawed. Mentioned from 6.0.

items.name: Stadium of the Sacred Flame
items.notes: Natlan's core landmark and its de facto capital/hub. Houses the Sacred Flame and hosts the Pyro Archon's seat and the Ode of Resurrection. Subarea of the Basin of Unnumbered Flames.

items.name: Stormterror's Lair
items.notes: location_type: subarea (ruined city), Brightcrown Mountains. Original capital of Old Mondstadt (Decarabian's city); later Dvalin's lair; Prologue Act III climax. 'Old Mondstadt' disambiguates here.

items.name: Sumeru
items.notes: added: fixed nation id

items.name: Sumeru City
items.notes: Capital, built in/around a giant tree in Avidya Forest; seat of the Akademiya.

items.name: Temple of Space
items.notes: Asmoday's private domain preserving objects/people from Teyvat; area added Luna VI (6.5). | location_type: area (separate map) in the sky above Windrest Peak. Aka Segment-Domain Tau / Hall of Emptiness; created by Asmoday as an exhibition hall preserving fallen civilizations (Hyperborea, Lang-Gan, Delphi Pytho, Ochkanatlan, Remuria, Arcadia); Watchers Nihilita and Melanta; 'Uplifted'. Quest: The Wind Has Ceased (A Long Day in the Mountains). | Also called Segment-Domain Tau / Hall of Emptiness. Asmoday's exhibition hall of fallen civilizations, in the sky above Windrest Peak, Mondstadt (the wiki region is 'Other'). Unlocked via The Wind Has Ceased from the Old Sanatorium Site. Dex helps explore it.

items.name: Tenshukaku
items.notes: Raiden Shogun's castle/seat of government; site of Vision Hunt Ceremony and Signora duel.

items.name: Teyvat
items.notes: The world, continent and planet. It sits on a spiral arm of an unnamed galaxy in the sea of stars. Today it has one moon, the Frost Moon; the Eternal and Iridescent Moons were destroyed. Top-level parent of all nations.

items.name: The Akademiya
items.notes: The physical Akademiya building in Sumeru City; the institution is a faction (faction.sumeru-akademiya).

items.name: The Chasm
items.notes: Mining subregion on Liyue's western coast that was once the site of ancient Lang-Gan. Covers both the surface area ('The Chasm (Area)') and the Underground Mines. Disambiguation page: 'The Chasm'.

items.name: The Mausoleum of King Deshret
items.notes: Pyramid in Hypostyle Desert; contains Great Hall of Truths and Aaru's Shut.

items.name: Tsurumi Island
items.notes: Fog-shrouded island; Thunderbird Civilization (Kanna Kapatcir) and Pre-Thunderbird Civilization ruins.

items.name: Vanarana
items.notes: Hidden Aranara homeland (dream realm), Aranyaka quest. Wiki splits into Vanarana (Area) and Vanarana (Subarea); covered as one entry. Includes Tree of Dreams, Vanarana Nursery.

items.name: Vimara Village
items.notes: Rainforest village in Ardravi Valley; Aranyaka/Aranara quests start nearby.

items.name: Wangshu Inn
items.notes: Inn above Dihua Marsh, run by Verr Goldet. Xiao stays here.

items.name: Watatsumi Island
items.notes: Formed from Orobashi's corpse; seat of Sangonomiya resistance. Version per 2.1 release (not confirmed from version page).

items.name: Yashiori Island
items.notes: Island cleaved by Musou no Hitotachi; Orobashi's remains and Tatarigami; Fort Fujitou/Fort Mumei.

items.name: Zapolyarny Palace
items.notes: Seat of the Belyi Tsar and then the Tsaritsa (Anastasya); interior instance accessible from 7.1. Merge 'Zapolyarny Palace (Instance)'.

items.name: Aaru
items.notes: King Deshret's unfinished afterlife ('far side of Eternity'); after Irminsul's destruction it serves as repository of ley line information/memories. Could alternatively be cosmology.afterlife; distinct from Aaru Village. Page changed in 'Luna VII'. | merged cosmology.aaru: Deshret's unfinished afterlife; since 6.6 the repository of Ley Line memories replacing Irminsul. Location scope may also list; introduced_in approximate.

items.name: Abdju Pit
items.notes: Land of Lower Setekh; Golden Slumber world quest (Khaenri'ah links) via Red Desert Threshold domain.

items.name: Aether and Lumine's Spaceship
items.notes: Vessel the Traveler and sibling used to travel between worlds; at Traveler's Crater (The Key That Unlocks Fate). | The twins' spaceship. It first landed in Nod-Krai; after the Cataclysm the Heavenly Principles moved it to the Frost Moon. First visited in Welkin Moon's Homecoming (6.3, inferred); permanently accessible from 6.7.

items.name: Anemo Archon Statue
items.notes: location_type: point of interest (statue), plaza before Favonius Cathedral; depicts Barbatos (hooded, winged).

items.name: Angel's Share
items.notes: location_type: point of interest (tavern), Mondstadt City. Owned by Diluc; Charles bartends; Venti's haunt.

items.name: Annapausis
items.notes: Submerged site of the former Narzissenkreuz Institute orphanage; Narzissenkreuz world quest series (Sword of Narzissenkreuz).

items.name: Apam Woods
items.notes: Ashavan Realm subarea; Grove of Dreams, The Rain's End; Tower of Abject Pride domain.

items.name: Apep's Resort
items.notes: Lair of Apep, Dendro Dragon Sovereign, in Desert of Hadramaveth.

items.name: Ardravi Valley
items.notes: Area: Port Ormos, Vimara Village, Devantaka Mountain.

items.name: Armory Palace
items.notes: 'Royal Armory Palace', weapons institution run by Sandrone, located deep within Glupov; wiki treats it as a FACTION (Fatui sub-faction) - may duplicate faction.armory-palace; no standalone location page. | merged faction.armory-palace: Royal Armory Palace, weapons R&D under Sandrone in Glupov; Special Assignments Battalion (Mitya's guards). Luna I = 6.0.

items.name: Ashavan Realm
items.notes: Area: Apam Woods, Caravan Ribat, Pardis Dhyai, Ruins of Dahri, Yasna Monument.

items.name: Ashveil Peak
items.notes: Northernmost area of Pohjola; Kipumaki Cliff, Cliffwatch Camp.

items.name: Atocpan
items.notes: Map area in southwest Natlan containing the Great Volcano of Tollan and the Collective of Plenty.

items.name: Ay-Khanoum
items.notes: Ancient 'City of the Moon Maiden', jointly ruled by Nabu Malikata and King Deshret, built for the Jinn; likely in today's Hypostyle Desert. Lore-only city.

items.name: Basin of Unnumbered Flames
items.notes: Map area in central Natlan. Contains the Stadium of the Sacred Flame and Huitztli Hill.

items.name: Belleau Region
items.notes: Area with Poisson, Romaritime Harbor (border with Sumeru), West Slopes of Mont Automnequi.

items.name: Beryl Region
items.notes: Area containing Elynas, Merusea Village, Elton Trench.

items.name: Bishui Plain
items.notes: Map area in northern Liyue. Includes Stone Gate, Wangshu Inn, Qingce Village, Dihua Marsh, Wuwang Hill and Sal Terrae.

items.name: Brightcrown Mountains
items.notes: location_type: area. Contains Brightcrown Canyon and Stormterror's Lair (ruins of Old Mondstadt).

items.name: Cage of Suchness
items.notes: location_type: subarea, Temple of Space. Where Asmoday resided with the Watchers; contains a coffin tied to the Traveler's sibling. | Temple of Space subarea.

items.name: Central Laboratory Ruins
items.notes: Site of Edwin Eastinghouse's Arkhium reactor explosion.

items.name: Chihu Rock
items.notes: Liyue Harbor district: the main plaza and dock-side market.

items.name: Chinvat Ravine
items.notes: Avidya Forest subarea; site of Withering/Fatui activity in early Archon Quest.

items.name: Chiwang Terrace
items.notes: Ancient ritual terrace on Mt. Laixin. Also a quest domain in 'An Ancient Sacrifice of Sacred Brocade'.

items.name: Chizhang Wall
items.notes: Remains of the ancient city of Chizhang, which the Mistress of Chenyu Vale governed.

items.name: Clink-Clank Krumkake Craftshop
items.notes: Aino's machine workshop (subarea of Lempo Isle) where Ineffa was built. First mentioned 5.5.

items.name: Cloud Retainer's Abode
items.notes: Cloud Retainer's pocket-realm home on Mt. Aocang. Appears as a quest domain where Shenhe and Xianyun live.

items.name: Coatepec Mountain
items.notes: Map area that is home to the Scions of the Canopy. Contains the Ancestral Temple, Teticpac Peak and Firethief's Secret Isle.

items.name: Court of Fontaine Region
items.notes: Map Area containing the capital, Salacia Plain, Annapausis, Opera Epiclese island (Erinnyes).

items.name: Cradle of Fleeting Dreams
items.notes: Castle-like central structure of Ochkanatlan.

items.name: Dainichi Mikoshi
items.notes: Artificial sun made by Aberaku no Mikoto (Hyperion/Helios); toggles Whitenight/Evernight. | Enkanomiya's artificial sun. Switches the realm between Whitenight and Evernight.

items.name: Dark Sea
items.notes: Umbrella term for lands and seas beyond Teyvat's seven nations, outside the Seven's dominion. Gods defeated in the Archon War fled here. Enkanomiya is also called part of it. | Umbrella term for unknown lands/seas outside the Seven's dominion; where defeated gods fled.

items.name: Dark Side of the Moon
items.notes: Far side of the Frost Moon; ancient dragon Project Moongazer base; Nibelung's space weapon. Merge with 'Dark Side of the Moon (Subarea)'. | Far side of the Frost Moon, with a base built by ancient dragon researchers for Project Moongazer. Reached via Project Moongazer (Part 2).

items.name: Dawn Winery
items.notes: location_type: subarea (winery estate), Windwail Highland. Chief winery, Ragnvindr Clan-owned ~1,000 years; Diluc inherited after Crepus's death.

items.name: Decarabian's Mondstadt
items.notes: location_type: historical nation/ancient civilization ('Old Mondstadt'). Decarabian's storm-walled realm, overthrown 2,600 years ago. Wiki treats as Ancient Civilization terminology; may fit lore.ancient-civilisations instead - dedupe with lore scope. | merged lore.decarabians-mondstadt: Old Mondstadt under the God of Storms, overthrown by Venti/Vennessa's rebels.

items.name: Decarabian's Tower
items.notes: location_type: point of interest (ruined tower) in Stormterror's Lair; seat of the God of Storms.

items.name: Desert of Hadramaveth
items.notes: 3.4 desert expansion: Gurabad, Mt. Damavand, Safhe Shatranj, Tanit Camps, Wadi Al-Majuj etc.

items.name: Domus Aurea
items.notes: Remus' royal palace made from his ship Fortuna; heart of the Grand Symphony Phobos.

items.name: Dornman Port
items.notes: location_type: subarea (port town), Windrest Peak, north of Cider Lake. Mentioned in lore since 1.0; playable in Luna VI (6.5). Knights base, Devil's Cut tavern; gateway toward Nod-Krai/Snezhnaya routes (verify).

items.name: Dragon-Queller
items.notes: Giant tree near Mt. Hulao and Nantianmen that holds Azhdaha's seal. Leads to the 'Beneath the Dragon-Queller' Trounce Domain.

items.name: Druzhna HQ
items.notes: Headquarters of the Druzhna in Snezhnograd.

items.name: Easybreeze Holiday Resort
items.notes: Also known as Tenochtzitoc ('Tenochtzitoc' redirects here). Island off Natlan's westernmost edge, where the war began and ended.

items.name: Entombed City - Ancient Palace
items.notes: location_type: subarea (ruins), Dragonspine. Buried palace of Sal Vindagnyr.

items.name: Erinnyes Forest
items.notes: Area; Weeping Willow, Roots of Erinnyes (Hauteclaire water-vein information system), Lumidouce Harbor. Name also refers to the island hosting Opera Epiclese.

items.name: Everfrozen Earth
items.notes: Northern frozen area containing Snezhnograd, Glupov, Morepesok (only northern port city), birch forestry.

items.name: Evernight Temple
items.notes: Enkanomiya temple; contains Tokoyo Reisen (River Lethe). | Enkanomiya subarea.

items.name: Favonius Keep
items.notes: Knights of Favonius expeditionary force camp (Varka).

items.name: Feiyun Slope
items.notes: Liyue Harbor district at the city entrance. Has old merchant houses, the Ministry of Civil Affairs and Wangsheng Funeral Parlor.

items.name: Fellfrost Peak
items.notes: Great mountain south of Snezhnograd; House of Hesperides, Jack Frost Village, Tidesong Cavern.

items.name: Flamefeather Valley
items.notes: Strange valley west of Snezhnograd, former human dwelling; ghost-story town; Shadow Realm shooter zone.

items.name: Fleuve Cendre
items.notes: Underground slum beneath the Court; outcasts and ex-convicts; Spina di Rosula de facto governs. Bar L'or noir located here.

items.name: Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering Region
items.wiki: Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering Region
items.notes: Map Area; distinct from the faction Fontaine Research Institute (faction scope). Site of the Arkhium reactor explosion, allogravity water cubes.

items.name: Forbidden Zone
items.notes: Secret Meropide area built over Primordial Water with sluice gate; Wingalet construction site.

items.name: Fountain of Lucine
items.notes: Fountain before Opera Epiclese where 'all water gathers'; Lucine is a remnant of Egeria's will (lore).

items.name: Frostbearing Tree
items.notes: location_type: point of interest (tree). New sprout of an ancient Irminsul tree destroyed by the Skyfrost Nail, revived by Durin's blood.

items.name: Frostmoon Enclave
items.notes: Frostmoon Scions' gathering place with Grand Library.

items.name: Galesong Hill
items.notes: location_type: area. Contains Windrise, Falcon Coast, Cape Oath, Dadaupa Gorge, Musk Reef.

items.name: Gavireh Lajavard
items.notes: Girdle of the Sands area: Gate of Zulqarnain, Temir Mountains, Tunigi Hollow, Hangeh Afrasiyab.

items.name: Golden Apple Archipelago
items.notes: location_type: limited-time event area (islands) east of Mondstadt, Summertime Odyssey events in 1.6 and 2.8; no longer accessible. Wiki gives no region; nation assignment is an assumption. | LIMITED-TIME summer event area east of Mondstadt, in neutral waters (1.6 Midsummer Island Adventure; 2.8 Summertime Odyssey). Historically the Haar Islands, formed when Barbatos split off mountaintops. Version-specific pages: Golden Apple Archipelago/1.6 and /2.8.

items.name: Grand Bazaar
items.notes: Lower-city marketplace containing Zubayr Theater.

items.name: Great Volcano of Tollan
items.notes: Active volcano covering all of Atocpan, called the 'Sacred Mountain' in ancient scrolls. The page 'Tollan' is a disambiguation between this and the Ancient Sacred Mountain.

items.name: Guizhong Ballista
items.notes: Ancient crossbow defence built by Guizhong and the adepti, Cloud Retainer among them. Used against Osial.

items.name: Gurabad
items.notes: Ancient 'City of Kings'/city of brass in SW Desert of Hadramaveth; Ormazd, Parvezravan, Shiruyeh, Liloupar; fell into a chasm via Abyssal power. | merged lore.gurabad: Liloupar's city; returns in Song of the Welkin Moon Act IX.

items.name: Guyun Stone Forest
items.notes: Stone spears that Rex Lapis threw to seal Osial and other enemies during the Archon War. Also home to the Domain of Guyun and the Alcor's mooring.

items.name: Hanamizaka
items.notes: Suburb/district of Inazuma City north of the river; Naganohara Fireworks, Bantan Sango.

items.name: Harvisptokhm
items.notes: Giant tree in Vourukasha Oasis serving as the God of the Pari; enterable interior.

items.name: Heart of the Sacred Mountain
items.notes: Space deep beneath the volcano that holds the heart of the primal flame (Phlogiston) and the dragons' final legacy.

items.name: Hexenzirkel's Island in the Sky
items.notes: location_type: point of interest (unofficial name), above Falcon Coast. Hexenzirkel tea-party meeting place, access kept by Barbatos. Wiki changelog says 3.5 (Alice/Hexenzirkel content); verify first appearance. | Unofficial name. Floating tea-party island of the Hexenzirkel above Falcon Coast, opened by incantation and kept by Barbatos. Permanently accessible after Paralogism. May overlap with the Mondstadt scope.

items.name: Hiisi Island
items.notes: Forested island of the Frostmoon Scions and Moon Goddess (Kuutar/Columbina) worship; relics resembling Secret Source tech. Mentioned 5.5.

items.name: House of Daena
items.notes: Akademiya library.

items.name: House of Hesperides
items.notes: Built millennia ago by first Grand Duchess of the Snegovik after Belyi Tsar founded the Pale Star Court; residence of Pavlina until Bell Ringing at Dusk. Mentioned Luna VI.

items.notes: Historical 'Golden City' kingdom in present-day Snezhnaya, part of the unified civilization; staging ground of Anacharsis and Koitar's failed rebellion vs Heavenly Principles; destroyed.
